examples.trans: Hello Thibault, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that.

meanings.note: Masculine material noun; combined with *en* or *d'* (*en acier*, *fil d'acier*).

examples.trans: The low and high strings are made of steel wire.

examples.text: Cette petite clé en acier est très solide.
examples.trans: This small steel wrench is very sturdy.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her

Imperative used to encourage.

examples.text: Allez, au travail!
examples.trans: Come on, to work!

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: for counting: vingt ans; for age: j'ai vingt ans

examples.trans: His twenty years of career.

examples.text: Elle a quarante ans.
examples.trans: She's forty.

meanings.note: Après le déjeuner.

examples.text: Après, elles ne peuvent plus s'arrêter.
examples.trans: Then they can't stop anymore.

examples.text: On mange, et après on part.
examples.trans: We eat, and afterwards we leave.

meanings.note: Masculine or feminine. This lesson uses masculine cet après-midi. Both après-midi and après-midis are accepted plural spellings.

examples.text: Je travaille cet après-midi.
examples.trans: I'm working this afternoon.

examples.text: Je vous en prie, madame. Lundi après-midi, l'entrée était sombre.
examples.trans: Go right ahead, madam. Monday afternoon, the lobby was dark.

meanings.note: No preposition: attendre quelqu'un.

examples.trans: Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!

examples.text: Attendez, cette rue est juste ici dans notre quartier, à cinq minutes!
examples.trans: Wait, that street is right here in our neighbourhood, five minutes away!

examples.text: Attendez. Regardez en bas sur la marche en pierre.
examples.trans: Wait. Look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Moi aussi = me too.

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Moi aussi.
examples.trans: Me too.

meanings.note: Time: avant mon départ.

examples.trans: Last meeting before I leave.

examples.text: Viens avant midi.
examples.trans: Come before noon.

examples.text: Tu déjeunes avec Audiard.
examples.trans: You're having lunch with Audiard.

examples.text: Avec plaisir!
examples.trans: With pleasure!

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40

meanings.en: helper verb of the passé composé
meanings.note: J'ai appelé = I called.

meanings.en: il y a = there is, there are

examples.trans: I've got a little loft.

examples.text: Tu as une réunion.
examples.trans: You have a meeting.

meanings.note: In mechanics and instrument making, *un axe* is the small metal pin around which a hinge or piano hammer pivots.

examples.trans: This tiny brass pin holds the hammer straight.

examples.text: Mettez une goutte d'huile sur l'axe de la roue.
examples.trans: Put a drop of oil on the wheel axle.

meanings.note: Can describe physical height or morally low behaviour.

examples.text: C'est vraiment bas.
examples.trans: That's really low.

examples.text: La table est basse.
examples.trans: The table is low.

examples.text: Attendez. Regardez en bas sur la marche en pierre.
examples.trans: Wait. Look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit

examples.text: C'est un bel endroit.
examples.trans: It's a lovely place.

examples.text: Il fait beau.
examples.trans: The weather is nice.

meanings.note: Très bien = very well, fine.

examples.text: Très bien.
examples.trans: Very well.

examples.text: Elle est bien.
examples.trans: She's nice.

examples.text: Les animaux sont dans les bois.
examples.trans: The animals are in the woods.

examples.text: La table est en bois.
examples.trans: The table is made of wood.

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

examples.text: Bon. Alors, je vais attendre.
examples.trans: Fine. Then I'll wait.

examples.text: Ah bon? Il y a un problème avec ma réservation?
examples.trans: Oh really? Is there a problem with my booking?

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to move'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'bougé').

examples.text: Le bébé bouge beaucoup.
examples.trans: The baby is moving a lot.

examples.text: Ne bougez plus, tous les deux.
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you.

examples.text: Stop, plus personne ne bouge! Quelle heure est-il? Neuf heures trente-cinq!
examples.trans: Hold everything, nobody move! What time is it? Nine thirty-five!

meanings.note: Faire du bruit = to make noise.

examples.text: Avec tout ce bruit.
examples.trans: With all this noise.

examples.text: Il y a beaucoup de bruit.
examples.trans: There's a lot of noise.

meanings.note: Caisse à outils = toolbox; la caisse = the till.

examples.text: Voici cinquante euros de la caisse. Rapportez le ticket!
examples.trans: Here is fifty euros from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!

examples.text: Vous avez une vanne de rechange dans votre caisse à outils?
examples.trans: Do you have a spare valve in your toolbox?

meanings.note: determiner: ce soir = tonight, cette semaine = this week
pronoun: c'est = it is; tout ce que = all that

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans? Dans cette même maison?
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? In that same house?

meanings.note: celle = feminine: celle de la semaine dernière

examples.trans: The one from last week?

examples.text: Je prends celui-là.
examples.trans: I'll take that one.

examples.text: Cette couleur est plus claire.
examples.trans: This colour is lighter.

examples.text: Le café est à côté.
examples.trans: The café is next door.

examples.text: Tu es une héroïne, Claire! Donne-moi le lait d'abord pour la machine à café.

meanings.note: J'étais dans les sous-vêtements.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans? Dans cette même maison?

examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.trans: Good. Put these fresh green herbs on top before serving.

examples.text: Son grand-père coupait du gâteau tiède au citron avec du sucre glace dessus!
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with icing sugar on top!

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth
dire à quelqu'un; dis-lui = tell her/him

examples.text: Trop tard! Il a dit merci et il a raccroché!

meanings.note: Parler doucement.

examples.trans: On the right, near the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Preposition. En retard means late; en vacances means on holiday.
Object pronoun replacing a phrase introduced by de. The English wording depends on the expression: en parler means to talk about it; j'en ai assez means I have had enough.
Object pronoun referring to an unspecified amount or to a quantity named after the action: j'en ai deux means I have two (of them).

examples.text: Tu es en vacances?

examples.text: Nous en parlons.

examples.text: Et demain?
examples.trans: And tomorrow?

examples.trans: Fifteen years polishing brass keys and ironing my ties... gone in thirty days!

meanings.note: Dans une heure = in an hour.

examples.trans: At eleven o'clock.

examples.text: Quelle heure est-il? Neuf heures trente-cinq!
examples.trans: What time is it? Nine thirty-five!

examples.text: L'horloger du quartier a réglé la pendule de l'entrée.
examples.trans: The neighborhood clockmaker adjusted the hall clock.

examples.text: C'est sympa ici.

Jouer au foot, jouer du piano.

examples.text: Il joue le frère de Guillaume.
examples.trans: He plays Guillaume's brother.

examples.text: Elle joue dans une pièce.
examples.trans: She's acting in a play.

meanings.note: Adverb: je veux juste.
Adjective.

examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.

examples.text: Sur la cour, juste au-dessus du vieux tilleul. C'est très calme.
examples.trans: The courtyard, right above the old linden tree. It is very quiet.

examples.text: Juste sous cette arche. Je vais monter la valise bleue pour vous.
examples.trans: Right under this archway. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: laisser quelqu'un voir = to let someone see
Laisse-moi = let me.

examples.text: Laissez vos photos ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos here.

examples.text: Laisse-moi parler!
examples.trans: Let me speak!

meanings.note: En laiton = made of brass.

examples.text: Il y a une lampe de lecture en laiton dans mon atelier en bas.
examples.trans: There is a brass reading lamp in my workshop downstairs.

examples.text: Branche la lampe en laiton d'Henri... oh, regarde cette belle lumière jaune!
examples.trans: Plug in Henri's brass lamp... oh, look at that lovely yellow light!

examples.text: Le film est fantastique.

examples.text: La pièce de Koltès.
examples.trans: The Koltès play.

meanings.note: être là = to be here, to be present

examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.

examples.trans: Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!

examples.text: À droite, près du bureau, là où la lumière est bonne.
examples.trans: On the right, near the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Bonjour, madame.
Abbreviated Mme.

examples.text: Merci, madame.
examples.trans: Thank you, madam.

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.en: a hand, help (un coup de main)

examples.text: Lave-toi les mains.
examples.trans: Wash your hands.

examples.text: Elle a un stylo à la main.
examples.trans: She has a pen in her hand.

examples.trans: I thank you a thousand times for this great role!

meanings.note: 1/1000 of a metre.

meanings.note: Stressed form: pour moi, avec moi.

examples.text: Et moi?
examples.trans: And me?

examples.text: Moi, c'est Henri. Vous êtes en avance de dix minutes.
examples.trans: I am Henri. You are ten minutes early.

meanings.note: ne... pas = not; ne... rien = nothing; ne... que = only; n' before a vowel

examples.trans: Nothing is signed.

examples.text: Attention dans le virage, ne cognez pas le mur!
examples.trans: Careful on the turn, do not bump the wall!

examples.text: C'est à neuf heures.

examples.text: J'ai neuf pages à lire.
examples.trans: I have nine pages to read.

examples.text: Vous pouvez? C'est à neuf heures.
examples.trans: Can you make it? It's at nine o'clock.

meanings.note: at the end of a sentence: super, non?

examples.trans: You can ride, can't you?

examples.text: Non, soulevez d'abord la poignée, puis poussez.
examples.trans: No, lift the handle first, then push.

meanings.note: une note de frais = an expense claim

examples.trans: My expense claims.

examples.text: Prends des notes.
examples.trans: Take notes.

examples.trans: All my notes from this week are inside. You saved me.

meanings.note: From noix ('walnut'); en noyer or en bois de noyer describes fine dark-grained walnut furniture and pianos.

examples.trans: The old walnut sideboard gleams after a coat of wax.

examples.text: Un grand noyer donne de l'ombre au fond du jardin.
examples.trans: A tall walnut tree gives shade at the back of the garden.

meanings.note: Idioms: *avoir une bonne oreille* ('to have a good ear for music') and *sourire jusqu'aux oreilles* ('to grin from ear to ear').

examples.text: Un bon accordeur écoute chaque corde avec une oreille attentive.
examples.trans: A good piano tuner listens to every string with an attentive ear.

examples.text: Il sourit jusqu'aux oreilles en voyant le salon terminé.
examples.trans: He grins from ear to ear seeing the finished parlor.

meanings.en: signboard, display board, road sign; wooden panel

examples.trans: The vendor wrote today's prices on a wooden sign.

examples.trans: A small sign points to the entrance of the tearoom.

meanings.en: unwanted, stray (*un bruit parasite* = buzz, rattle, static)

meanings.note: Affectionate, a bit condescending.

examples.text: Si je connais?! Chaque vendredi pendant six ans, j'ai monté cet escalier en bois pour donner cours de piano!
examples.trans: Do I know it?! Every Friday for six years, I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: Un menuisier vivait là avec ses deux petits-fils: l'aîné jouait du piano, et le petit adorait les trains!
examples.trans: A carpenter lived there with his two grandsons: the older boy played piano, and the little one loved trains!

meanings.note: La pièce de Koltès.
In a flat.

examples.text: Je dois voir la pièce.
examples.trans: I have to see the play.

examples.text: Un appartement de trois pièces.
examples.trans: A three-room flat.

meanings.note: With ne: je n'en peux plus.
pronounced plys at the end of a sentence in this sense

examples.text: Il n'est plus là.
examples.trans: He's not here any more.

examples.text: Henri est deux fois plus curieux que nous!
examples.trans: Henri is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Both *-d-* and *-s* are silent (`/pwa/`), and singular and plural are spelled identically (*un poids, des poids*).

examples.text: Appuyez sur la touche de tout le poids de votre main.
examples.trans: Press the key with the full weight of your hand.

examples.text: L'étagère en bois massif supporte facilement ce poids.
examples.trans: The solid wood shelf easily supports that weight.

meanings.note: + infinitive.
conditional: tu pourrais, vous pourriez

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir.
examples.trans: I can't come.

examples.text: Vous pouvez faire l'aller-retour en dix minutes?
examples.trans: Can you run there and back in ten minutes?

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'precise'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Il donne des ordres précis au garde.
examples.trans: He gives precise orders to the guard.

examples.text: Pourquoi il y a des dessins précis de trois hôtels de notre rue?
examples.trans: Why are there neat drawings of three hotels on our street?

meanings.note: Connects actions in sequence.

examples.text: Il travaille, puis il rentre.
examples.trans: He works, then he goes home.

examples.text: Non, soulevez d'abord la poignée, puis poussez.
examples.trans: No, lift the handle first, then push.

meanings.note: On a piano, the right sustain *pédale* lifts the dampers so notes ring warmly together.

examples.text: Les deux pédales en laiton du piano brillent comme de l'or.
examples.trans: The piano's two brass pedals shine like gold.

examples.text: Appuyez doucement sur la pédale de droite à la fin de l'accord.
examples.trans: Press gently on the right pedal at the end of the chord.

related.gloss: key (of a piano or keyboard), button

meanings.note: Question word or conjunction.

examples.text: Vous serez là quand?
examples.trans: When will you be here?

examples.text: Quand tu veux.
examples.trans: Whenever you like.

meanings.note: Joins two parts: dis-lui que.
Relative: tout ce que.
With ne: ne... que.
Ça fait trois semaines que.

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
examples.trans: Tell her I can't come.

examples.text: Je n'ai que deux places.
examples.trans: I've only got two tickets.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to fill up'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: La salle est déjà bien remplie.
examples.trans: The hall is already well filled.

examples.text: Il remplit son verre d'eau.
examples.trans: He fills his glass of water.

examples.text: Je tourne doucement... écoutez! L'eau remplit le tuyau!
examples.trans: Turning slowly... listen! Water is filling the pipe!

retrouver.gloss: to get back, recover, find again

meanings.note: *Retrouver sa voix* means 'to get one's voice back' (both for a person and figuratively for an instrument).

examples.text: Une fois accordé, le vieux piano retrouve toute sa chaleur.
examples.trans: Once tuned, the old piano regains all its warmth.

examples.text: J'ai enfin retrouvé mes lunettes sur l'étagère de l'entrée!
examples.trans: I finally found my glasses again on the hall shelf!

revisser.gloss: to screw back on, tighten screws

meanings.note: Formed from *re-* + *visser* (from *la vis*, 'screw').

examples.text: Il revisse le panneau avant du piano avec son tournevis.
examples.trans: He screws the front panel of the piano back on with his screwdriver.

examples.text: Revissez bien la poignée en laiton pour qu'elle ne bouge plus.
examples.trans: Screw the brass handle back on tight so it doesn't wobble.

rond.gloss: round; in circles (in tourner en rond)

meanings.en: round, circular; in circles (in tourner en rond)

examples.text: On tourne en rond depuis une heure.
examples.trans: We have been going in circles for an hour.

examples.text: Ils sont assis autour d'une table ronde.
examples.trans: They are sitting around a round table.

ré.gloss: D (second musical note: do, ré, mi)

meanings.note: French names musical notes with solfège syllables (do, ré, mi, fa, sol, la, si) rather than letters C–B; invariable masculine noun: le ré du milieu = middle D.

examples.text: Sur ce vieux piano, le ré du milieu ne sonne plus.
examples.trans: On this old piano, the middle D no longer sounds.

examples.text: Odette accorde doucement le la et le ré.
examples.trans: Odette gently tunes the A and the D.

meanings.note: Reflexive.

meanings.en: s'arrêter de + infinitive: to stop doing

examples.text: Le bus s'arrête ici.
examples.trans: The bus stops here.

examples.text: Je ne peux plus m'arrêter.
examples.trans: I can't stop anymore.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'dry'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Du pain sec.
examples.trans: Dry bread.

examples.text: Une feuille sèche.
examples.trans: A dry leaf.

examples.text: Antoine l'a posé quand il a pris la serviette sèche!
examples.trans: Antoine set it down when he took the dry towel!

meanings.note: From *serrer* ('to tighten'); *tenir bien serré* means 'to fit snugly / hold tight' (and *un café serré* is a short espresso!).

examples.text: La vis neuve tient bien serrée dans le bois sec.
examples.trans: The new screw holds nice and tight in the dry wood.

examples.text: Ne faites pas un nœud trop serré sur le tablier.
examples.trans: Don't tie too tight a knot on the apron.

meanings.note: Masculine noun (*le silence*, *trente ans de silence*), unlike most *-ence* nouns in French!

examples.text: On entend résonner chaque note dans le silence du matin.
examples.trans: You can hear every note ring out in the morning silence.

examples.text: Après une seconde de silence, toute la salle applaudit.
examples.trans: After a second of silence, the whole room applauds.

meanings.note: Walking surface indoors or outdoors.

examples.text: Et pas de miroir au mur, et le sol semble nu sans tapis.
examples.trans: And no mirror on the wall, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: Bonsoir. Pardon pour l'eau sur votre sol propre.
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for the water on your clean floor.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun owned (son sac, sa valise, ses clés); used before feminine vowel-initial nouns too.
Masculine noun: le son du piano.

examples.text: Ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: His twenty years of career.

examples.text: C'est son agent.
examples.trans: It's her agent.

meanings.note: A telephone or bell rings.
For how something sounds to the ear, including an appealing name or idea.

examples.text: Ça sonne vraiment bien.
examples.trans: That sounds really good.

examples.text: Le téléphone sonne.
examples.trans: The phone is ringing.

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Standard word for 'aunt' (informal family nickname: tata or tatie).

examples.text: La tante d'Étienne jouait merveilleusement bien du piano.
examples.trans: Étienne's aunt used to play the piano wonderfully.

examples.text: Ma tante a écrit toutes ses recettes à l'encre bleue.
examples.trans: My aunt wrote all her recipes in blue ink.

meanings.note: Imperative: tiens! / tenez!.
Imperative: tiens! / tenez!.

examples.text: Tenez, les voilà.
examples.trans: Here, there they are.

examples.text: Il tient un livre.
examples.trans: He's holding a book.

touche.gloss: key (of a piano or keyboard), button

meanings.en: key (of a piano, organ, or keyboard)
meanings.note: Keep distinct from une clé (a door lock key or a musical clef symbol on a staff): the physical black and white keys you press on a piano are les touches.

examples.text: Une seule touche du vieux piano reste encore muette.
examples.trans: Only one key on the old piano is still silent.

examples.text: Odette essuie délicatement les quatre-vingt-huit touches.
examples.trans: Odette gently wipes the eighty-eight piano keys.

meanings.note: Tournez le visage = turn your face.
Cinema.

examples.text: Elle tourne un film.
examples.trans: She's shooting a film.

examples.text: Tournez à gauche.
examples.trans: Turn left.

examples.text: Tout va bien.
examples.trans: Everything is going well.

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

examples.text: Elle a trente ans.
examples.trans: She's thirty.

examples.text: Trente euros, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Thirty euros, please.

meanings.note: indefinite article; des in the plural
Number; l'un = one of them.

examples.text: Et voilà la cloche du portail. Un coup franc.
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.

examples.text: Voilà un taxi devant le portail à l'instant.
examples.trans: Here comes a taxi in front of the gate right now.

meanings.en: waltz (piece of music or dance in 3/4 time)
meanings.note: Feminine noun covering both the dance and an instrumental piece written in three-quarter time.

examples.text: Odette joue une petite valse douce pour l'heure du thé.
examples.trans: Odette plays a gentle little waltz for teatime.

examples.text: Cette valse compte trois temps par mesure.
examples.trans: This waltz has three beats to a bar.

meanings.note: before the noun; vieil before a vowel: un vieil ami

examples.text: C'est un vieux film.
examples.trans: It's an old film.

examples.text: Non, seulement mon stylo et trois vieux tickets!
examples.trans: No, only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.en: glass-walled, glazed (*une porte vitrée*, *une pièce vitrée*)
meanings.note: From *la vitre* ('windowpane'); describes doors, verandas, or sunrooms enclosed with panes of glass.

examples.text: Le soleil du matin inonde toute la petite pièce vitrée.
examples.trans: Morning sunlight floods the whole little glass-walled room.

examples.text: Fermez doucement la porte vitrée qui donne sur la cour.
examples.trans: Gently close the glass door leading out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: same form in singular and plural; à voix basse = in a low voice

examples.text: Une voix polie? Jeune ou âgée?
examples.trans: A polite voice? Young or old?

examples.text: Excusez-moi, madame... attendez. Cette voix! Madame Odette, ma professeure de piano?!
examples.trans: Excuse me, madam... wait. That voice! Madam Odette, my piano teacher?!

examples.text: Tu perds la voix?
examples.trans: Are you losing your voice?

related.word: same form in singular and plural; à voix basse

meanings.note: Polite or plural 'you'.

examples.text: Votre nom?
examples.trans: Your name?

examples.text: Laissez vos photos ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos here.

meanings.note: One person, formal.
Several people.
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back

examples.text: Vous êtes où?
examples.trans: Where are you?

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.en: zero; scratch (repartir de zéro = start from scratch)
meanings.note: Zéro degré = zero degrees. Masculine noun ('le zéro', plural 'les zéros') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'zero'.

examples.text: Repartir de zéro.
examples.trans: To start from scratch.

examples.text: Un soda zéro sucre.
examples.trans: A zero-sugar soda.

examples.text: Comment est ma cravate aujourd'hui, Claire? Zéro goutte de jus d'orange en vue!
examples.trans: How is my tie today, Claire? Zero drops of orange juice in sight!

meanings.note: Place: à Paris, à mon cours.
Time: à midi.

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
meanings.note: Contractions.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: À quatorze heures.
examples.trans: At two pm.

meanings.note: Informal for cela.
With time.

examples.text: Je prends ça.
examples.trans: I'll take that.

examples.text: Ça fait trois semaines.
examples.trans: It's been three weeks.

meanings.note: No preposition.

meanings.en: écoute = listen, look (to start a point)
meanings.note: Casual imperative.

examples.text: Écoute, c'est difficile.
examples.trans: Listen, it's difficult.

examples.text: J'écoute la radio.
examples.trans: I'm listening to the radio.

meanings.note: The most common verb.
Ce + est.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: C'est important.
examples.trans: It's important.
